title: HostState
description: Native module-surface states every host must present. Terminal gate states are decided natively before any module JavaScript runs: notInstalled (no runnable installation for the signed-in account), integrityFailed (bundled manifest digest ≠ verified install descriptor), updateRequired (host/bridge outside the manifest's semver ranges), permissionDenied (policy withholds a required capability). `expired` follows 15 minutes without bridge activity; activity renews the TTL.
